meta.beh: Places one block in the bin from the tray during independent work
meta.setting: Room 12, independent math and writing blocks
meta.who: Aide A in the morning, Aide B in the afternoon
meta.tokForm: Laminated stars on a velcro strip fixed to the desk, in the student’s line of sight
meta.tokWhy: Visible and countable from across the room, durable, and not itself a preferred item so it does not compete with the task
meta.tokEstab: Being established now — pairing plan below
meta.tokEvid: The backups have been tested, not the stars: the reinforcer assessment on Form RA-1 confirmed tablet access and the fruit chew, and praise did not function as a reinforcer, so it is not used as a backup. The token board was nominated on RA-1 but not tested, so the stars have not yet been shown to function as reinforcers apart from the backups.
meta.tokPlan: Exchange after one token for the first two sessions, then two, then to the current five. Token handed over with the statement naming what it was earned for.
meta.tp: FR 10 — ten blocks placed earn one star
meta.ep: FR 5 — five stars open an exchange
meta.te: Each star buys 1 min of tablet during the exchange period; five stars buy 5 min
meta.exWhen: End of each independent work block, 5 min, at the desk
meta.exDelay: Under 10 s — the fifth star is handed over and the exchange begins immediately
meta.lossRule: Token loss is not used. The team considered it and decided against: it is a punishment procedure, would require review, and the system is producing the behavior without it.
meta.refresh: Brief MSWO each Monday (Form PA-1), and any backup refused twice is replaced
meta.econ: Open — the backups are also available outside the system
meta.rights: Food, drink, breaks, the bathroom, belongings, and adult attention are not earnable. The fruit chew on the menu is an extra offered alongside snack, never in place of it.
meta.audAction: Three items outstanding. The stars have not been tested as reinforcers apart from the backups — a test goes on the next reinforcer assessment (Form RA-1). The student cannot yet request an exchange independently — a request card goes in this week. Integrity has not been observed since the schedule was thinned; a TI-1 check is scheduled within ten school days.
